third_party_evaluations.summary: SRX policy, NAT, IPsec VPN, ALGs, and Junos security services for specialist engineers.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 3. The ordered median is associate. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded two-year policy, VPN and NAT scope supports an associate implementer despite the Specialist title; production relevance does not establish broader design ownership outside Junos.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded SRX policy, NAT, VPN and security-services coverage with two years of experience fits associate platform engineering. The Specialist title does not require a separate advanced specialty tier for this normal vendor progression.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded SRX policies, NAT, VPN and security services fit focused two-year operational competence. Specialist branding does not make this an unordered niche or a higher career tier.
